title: GLM-4 9B Chat joins the text models
summary:
One PR reshaped the text model lineup: GLM-4 9B Chat was added, three OpenAI routes moved to GPT-4.1 Nano, and the model list got a trim.

Added GLM-4 9B Chat through Intelligence.io with an 8,192-token model configuration.

Updated openai, openai-fast, and openai-roblox to route to Azure GPT-4.1 Nano. The openai listing replaces GPT-4o Mini, while openai-roblox moves to anonymous access.

Set DeepSeek R1 0528’s maximum output to 2,000 tokens and removed openai-reasoning (O3) from the available model list.

highlights.title: GLM-4 9B Chat added
highlights.text: Try GLM-4 9B Chat, added with an 8,192-token model configuration. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=GLM-4).

highlights.title: OpenAI routes get Nano
highlights.text: `openai`, `openai-fast`, and `openai-roblox` now route to Azure GPT-4.1 Nano; the `openai` listing replaces GPT-4o Mini. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).
